name: Kitchen Table: Spades, Hearts
subtitle: Euchre, Whist, Oh Hell. No ads
promotional_text: Pull up a chair. Hearts is free for good, and one unlock you keep adds Spades, Euchre, Oh Hell and Classic Whist. No ads, no subscription, no account. Just cards.
description:
Pull up a chair. The coffee's on, the cards are shuffled, and nobody is going to show you an ad.

Kitchen Table is the card games you grew up with, played the way you remember them: Hearts, Spades, Euchre, Oh Hell and Classic Whist (partnership whist, no bidding), with computer players who play like real people and wait as long as you need.

WHAT YOU PAY
- Hearts is free, for good. No trial, no timer.
- One $6.99 unlock adds Spades, Euchre, Oh Hell and Classic Whist, and every game we add later, starting with Bid Whist, which is coming. You pay once and keep it.
- No ads, ever. No subscription. No account to make.
- Family Sharing is on: one purchase covers your household.
- Table themes are optional extras for anyone who wants to dress up the table.

A FAIR DEAL YOU CAN CHECK
Every hand is shuffled from a random seed and your cut. Your score, your winning streak and what you bought play no part. Before the deal you see the seed's fingerprint, then you cut the deck yourself. The seed and the cut are printed on every score sheet, and our website re-deals any hand from its seed and cut, card for card. The fair deal ledger in the app keeps count of the hands you've been dealt next to what a fair deck gives on average.

PARTNERS WHO MAKE SENSE
- Four levels: Easy, Standard, Expert and Extreme.
- Tap "Why?" and your partner tells you, in plain words, why they played that card.
- Your turn waits for you. Nothing is played for you while you think.

YOUR HOUSE RULES
Play it Standard, the Kitchen table way, or by Tournament rules, or set each rule yourself: passing, shooting the moon, nil and blind nil, bags, jokers, stick the dealer and more. Every rule says in one line what it does.

EASY ON THE EYES
- Comfort mode: bigger cards, bigger buttons and a slower table.
- Large and extra large text.
- A four-color deck, so diamonds and clubs stand out.
- Tap twice to play, so a slip of the finger never costs a trick.
- Works with VoiceOver, and "Read the table aloud" speaks every play with the phone's own voice.
- A gentle vibration on your turn.
- A caregiver page with a PIN: lock purchases and settings, choose which games show, or open straight into a game.

THE LITTLE THINGS
- A score sheet after every hand, the way you'd keep it on a notepad.
- Close the app mid-hand and your cards are right where you left them.
- Plays offline, on the porch or on the plane.
- Game Center leaderboards for best games, wins and streaks, if you like that sort of thing.
- Soft, quiet sounds, and the ring/silent switch is respected.

We ask before we collect anything. If you say yes, we get anonymous usage numbers and crash reports to make the game better; if you say no, nothing is sent. You can change your mind in Options.

Kitchen Table is made by one small team. Thank you for sitting down with us.
